name: okovia
description: OkOvia browser telemetry SDK — sends product behavior context (no prompts, responses, or sensitive data) so AI cost can be attributed to features.

scripts.build: npm run build:esm && npm run build:cjs && npm run build:cdn
scripts.build:cdn: esbuild src/tag.ts --bundle --format=iife --minify --target=es2019 --banner:js="/* OkOvia Tag — same build served at okovia.com/js/okovia.js. Add data-key to the script tag. */" --outfile=dist/okovia.tag.js
scripts.build:tag: esbuild src/tag.ts --bundle --format=iife --minify --target=es2019 --banner:js="/* OkOvia Tag — generated from sdks/javascript (npm run build:tag). Do not edit. */" --outfile=../../apps/web/public/js/okovia.js
